dimensions.title: Component placement
dimensions.description: Search the two-dimensional placement of declared components.
dimensions.bound_basis: The design-predicate and board geometry gates remain the authority; no independent bound is declared.

dimensions.title: Component rotation
dimensions.description: Search the rotation of declared components in the board frame.
dimensions.bound_basis: The board projection and Kicad DRC gates remain the authority; no independent bound is declared.

dimensions.title: GPIO assignment
dimensions.description: Search firmware GPIO assignments among graph-declared MCU pads.
dimensions.value_source: graph nodes fw.pin.* and electrical MCU pad assignments
dimensions.bound_basis: The pin_firmware_alignment and electrical routing gates remain the authority; no independent bound is declared.

dimensions.title: Track width
dimensions.value_source: graph attributes electrical.board.min_track_mm and netclass width attributes
dimensions.bound_basis: The fab profile and routing-width/DRC gates remain the authority; no independent bound is declared.

dimensions.title: Copper layer count
dimensions.description: The selected board copper layer count and its projection.
dimensions.value_source: graph attribute electrical.board.layers and selected fab profile
dimensions.bound_basis: The selected fab profile and board projection remain the authority; no independent bound is declared.
dimensions.search_disabled_reason: Changing layer count changes fab profile selection and board projection; J-3 profile registry work is out of scope for this session.

dimensions.title: Copper clearance
dimensions.value_source: graph attributes electrical.board.min_clearance_mm and fab profile capabilities
dimensions.bound_basis: The fab profile and Kicad DRC gates remain the authority; no independent bound is declared.

dimensions.title: Via rule
dimensions.description: Search the declared routing via geometry and rule choice.
dimensions.value_source: graph attributes electrical.board.via_diameter_mm and via_drill_mm plus fab profile capabilities
dimensions.bound_basis: The fab profile, routing, DRC, and ground-plane gates remain the authority; no independent bound is declared.

dimensions.title: Router maximum passes
dimensions.description: Search the bounded router pass budget supplied to the pipeline.
dimensions.bound_basis: The router convergence gate remains the authority; no independent bound is declared.

dimensions.title: Mechanical datum
dimensions.description: The datum used to resolve mechanical placement and dimensions.
dimensions.bound_basis: The mechanical projection and interference gates remain the authority; no independent bound is declared.
dimensions.search_disabled_reason: Single-datum consolidation is B-6 and has not yet been implemented.
